::: {.column-body padding="60px" style="text-align: center;"}
I am a PhD candidate in Economic Sociology, Organisation, and Labour at the University of Milan. My research examines how experiencing or witnessing economic hardship in one’s social and geographical proximity erodes trust in political institutions. On this website, you will find a selection of my data analysis projects (both the serious and the *unserious*) as well as tutorials and teaching material. Check out the [about](about.qmd) section to get to know me better.
:::
